name: FreeToken
description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.
one_liner: Lets a gaming PC run AI models the size you'd normally need a data center for, by only loading the small part of the model each answer actually needs.
buyer: A small company that wants to run a large, capable AI model privately on owned hardware instead of paying per-token to a cloud API.
business_use_cases: A law firm or healthcare practice runs a frontier-scale model on an in-office workstation so client data never leaves the building.
An AI dev-tools company offers 'bring your own GPU' local inference to developers worried about per-token costs on large coding tasks.
A hardware reseller bundles a pre-configured 'private AI workstation' with FreeToken preinstalled for small businesses.

money_ideas.idea: Sell preconfigured private-AI hardware bundled with support.
Paid tuning and consulting to get a specific model running fast on a customer's exact hardware.

steal_this: Sell a turnkey 'private ChatGPT in a box' appliance to small professional-services firms (law, medical, accounting) worried about client data leaving their office.
